name: Kaynes Technology India Ltd
title: Kaynes Technology India Ltd - 543664 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Kaynes missed its FY26 revenue guidance (INR4,500 cr cut to ~INR4,000 cr, delivered ~INR3,626 cr) and OCF was about INR600 cr negative, driven by metering receivables of ~INR1,365 cr; no numeric FY27 guidance given.

triggers.label: FY26 revenue guide cut INR4,500 cr → ~INR3,600 cr
triggers.quote: we ended the year with close to INR3,600 crores of revenue

triggers.label: No numeric FY27 guidance; 'not giving a guidance'
triggers.quote: Our idea was not to give a guidance.

triggers.label: Metering receivables INR1,365 cr
triggers.quote: it's about INR1,365 crores, including the -- in the total revenue, the receivables on this business

triggers.label: OSAT visibility >INR25,000 mn over 5 years
triggers.quote: revenue visibility of over INR25,000 million over the next 5 years

guidance.value: Outgrow EMS market at 2x market growth (~15-16%)
guidance.quote: we'll be doubling the market growth

guidance.value: PCB INR300-400 cr; OSAT INR250-300 cr
guidance.quote: PCB of around INR300 crores to INR400 crores, and OSAT of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores
rail business, I'm expecting this year to grow by around 20%, 25%

prior_guidance_check.quote: we ended the year with close to INR3,600 crores of revenue
it has come at almost INR1,000 crores
our cash flow was INR250 crores positive when compared to INR65 crores last year

red_flags.label: Guidance cut and missed
red_flags.quote: we sincerely understand and appreciate that the guidance what we have given, we could not meet

red_flags.label: OCF deeply negative; metering receivables up
red_flags.quote: the total number has gone up because of this

red_flags.label: Management/board restructuring
red_flags.quote: There has been some top management restructuring and role realignment in this phase.

red_flags.label: Evasive on guidance
red_flags.quote: Sorry, if we have made you to put it in a confusing state by not giving the exact number.

evasions.quote: we are committing for our growth based on what market can pull in
we will try to work on the positive, but at least 70% to 80% of this will come down for sure
we have only discounted to around INR40 crores or so
